response_doctrine.authority: Police (Politi) hold primary response. CPH Airports A/S security handles perimeter reporting. Naviair handles ATC-side airspace coordination.
triggers: Any airborne unknown inside published control zone triggers immediate ATC notification.
Dwell over runway approach corridor or ILS glideslope triggers dispatch of ground unit within 5 minutes.
Formation of 2+ non-cooperative airframes triggers police + military liaison.
response_doctrine.coordination: Airport ops centre coordinates ground movements. Police make the go/no-go call on any escalation beyond monitor.

site_red_flags: Dwell overhead any runway threshold (approach or departure) beyond 60 seconds — reads as targeting the approach path.
Dwell over the airside fuel farm — reads as reconnaissance of the highest-consequence target.
Loitering over Pier E stands during widebody turnaround windows — payload exposure.
Non-cooperative airframe crossing runway centerline below 500 ft AGL — treat as runway incursion regardless of intent.
